name: Store Restriction for WooCommerce – Product Visibility & Access Control
author: WooSofts

sections.description:
Store Restriction for WooCommerce transforms your WooCommerce store into a powerful restricted access platform. Whether you’re running a wholesale business, B2B marketplace, or members-only shop, our plugin gives you complete control over product visibility and access based on user roles, geographic location, and more.

Plugin Documentation

🔥 Key Features

  • Role-Based Restrictions: Control product visibility by user roles (Customer, Wholesale, VIP, etc.)
  • Country-Based Restrictions: Geo-restrict products and categories for territory-specific sales
  • Category Protection: Set restrictions at the category level for efficient management
  • Individual Product Control: Apply granular restrictions to specific products
  • Bulk Management: Efficiently manage multiple restrictions at once
  • Custom Restriction Messages: Create tailored messages for restricted users
  • Global Store Settings: Control store-wide restriction policies

🎯 Perfect For

  • Wholesale Stores – Hide retail prices from non-wholesale users
  • B2B Marketplaces – Create business-only shopping experiences
  • Members-Only Shops – Restrict access to exclusive customers
  • Country-Specific Stores – Comply with regional sales restrictions
  • Private Shopping Clubs – Create exclusive shopping experiences
  • Age-Restricted Products – Control access to appropriate audiences
  • Educational Product Stores – Restrict by student or institution roles

🚀 Professional Tools

  • Advanced user role management system
  • Flexible country restriction settings
  • Category-level protection mechanisms
  • Custom restriction messages and redirects
  • Intuitive, easy-to-use interface
  • Global store configuration options

Third Party Services

This plugin uses:
* Material-UI (MUI) – https://mui.com/material-ui/

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “Store Restriction for WooCommerce”
  3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Store Restriction to configure settings

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin from WordPress.org
  2. Upload the entire store-restriction-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  4. Navigate to WooCommerce > Store Restriction to begin setup
sections.faq:
Is this compatible with WooCommerce membership plugins?

Yes! Our plugin seamlessly integrates with WooCommerce Memberships and other popular membership plugins to enhance your restriction capabilities.

Can I restrict products based on customer location?

Absolutely! You can restrict products, categories, or your entire store based on customer countries using our built-in geo-restriction feature – perfect for region-specific sales requirements.

How do I set up wholesale-only products?

Simply create a wholesale user role, then use our role-based restrictions to make specific products or categories visible only to wholesale customers. This creates a professional B2B experience.

Can I hide prices from guest users?

Yes! You can easily control price visibility based on user roles, perfect for wholesale and B2B stores that need to keep pricing confidential.

Does this work with the latest version of WooCommerce?

Yes, we regularly update our plugin to ensure compatibility with the latest WooCommerce version. We’re committed to keeping pace with WooCommerce developments.

Where can I get support?

We offer comprehensive support through:
* Our support portal
* Detailed documentation
* Email support at support@woosofts.com
